title: APS 04–05 – Algorithm techniques
description: Midterm 1 theory: brute force, greedy, divide and conquer, dynamic programming, backtracking, knapsack, bin packing, scheduling, Huffman codes.

questions.question: When does divide and conquer become inefficient?

options.text: When the problem is solved with binary search

questions.question: When is it best to apply divide and conquer?

options.text: When only one locally best choice has to be made at each step
